component.title: Inspector Layout
component.purpose: Keep inspector controls and content legible across desktop and compact layouts.

states.description: The inspector and canvas are ready.
The inspector has no applicable content.
The canvas remains usable while inspector data is incomplete.
The inspector exposes a recoverable error.

behaviors.description: The canvas remains the primary task region while the inspector owns its own lifecycle state.
The inspector moves below the canvas on narrow widths while preserving the title, toolbar, and state content order.
The canvas keeps a bounded working surface and visual grid so state changes do not collapse the work area.
